origins.section: 14.4 `<attr>` Is Set Through JMX, So Its Setter Belongs in the MBean Interface
14.3 A Configuration Refused in `setConfiguration` Renames the File; Refused Later, It Only Logs
14.5 Nothing Is Started Until Everything Is Initialised, So a QBean Looks for What It Needs in `startService`
14.6 Q2 Deploys Whatever It Finds in `deploy/`, Even Half a File

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-key-rotation: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-key-rotation: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-key-rotation: 14.4 decides it: Q2 sets <attr> through the MBean server, which knows only QBeanSupportMBean's attributes when the bean has no interface of its own, so the unknown attribute fails the deploy and the file is renamed .BAD.
recorded.prompt:q-fee-table: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-fee-table: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-fee-table: 14.3 decides it: an Unknown bean's start() returns at once, so startService never runs, and the JMX start run leaves 61_cutover_init.xml Unknown.
recorded.prompt:q-scoring: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-scoring: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-scoring: 14.5 decides it with the pool-last run: starts run one after another on Q2's thread in file order, so the waiting bean blocks the provider's start and ends Failed.
recorded.prompt:q-script: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-script: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-script: 14.6 decides it: Q2 parses a new file as soon as it appears, and the fix is to write the file outside deploy/ on the same file system and move it in.
